headline: CHC @ PIT matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHC 4.50 at PIT 3.70, with a projected total of 8.20. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHC: CHC moved +0.18 runs while PIT moved -0.62, changing the projected margin by +0.81 runs. The projected total fell -0.44, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -5.0%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Ben Brown has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Konnor Griffin, Alex Bregman, Bryan Reynolds, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ian Happ, Michael Conforto because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
